Carlos: Congrats!! I will bring a savory tray and coffee. CoffeeBot: Coffee delivery scheduled Mon 14:55 for "Random Team".

PeopleOpsBot: Promo effective Mon. HR will send the announcement post-standup. Congratulations, Maya!

Carlos: Song rec for the tiny playlist: "Home" by Edward Sharpe.
